caption:
School team, club training and weekend games. Lately Toto's knees ache every time he runs.

Growing bodies need rest days as much as training. Building load up gradually and working on balance and core control can often help young athletes keep playing comfortably.

Hybi's routine: single-leg stand 30 seconds × 3, side plank on knees 20 seconds × 3, bridges 10 reps × 2 sets, 2–3 times a week.

Limping, a tender bony spot, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Parents, chat to our team about clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio
